claim.operational_target: Bind a stable person model and one independently confirmed predictive mechanism into one signed, recomputable identity used by prediction and active experiment planning.
non_claims: The selected structure is the person's true causal or psychological mechanism.
An existing base-relative dynamic state can be added without mechanism-relative re-inference.
alternatives: The stable base model alone is sufficient.
The apparent mechanism is temporal change or confounding.
The mechanism candidate set omits the real predictive structure.
claim.scope: One bound person, base model, confirmed mechanism evidence lineage, shared supported feature/domain/option/context scope, and component expiry window.

identifiability.distinguishing_evidence: The mechanism component must already pass preregistered discovery, independent selection, sealed confirmation, calibration, applicability, and expiry gates; the composite layer adds no semantic interpretation.
unidentified_questions: Causal and psychological interpretation remains unidentified.
Trial completeness still requires an external registry.
Dynamic state must be re-inferred relative to this composite before joint use.

roles: future active experiment result and validation ledgers
evidence.completeness_boundary: Signed supplied evidence is recomputed; undisclosed trials and externally false timestamps require a transparency log or trusted registry.

computation.deployment_kernel: math_utils.logistic_normal_probability over the joint base-plus-mechanism Gaussian logit view
computation.selection_kernel: The same joint Gaussian logit view supplies active-experiment predictive probability and mutual information.
computation.uncertainty_scope: Block-diagonal conditional Gaussian approximation; base/correction correlation, candidate selection, and omitted model form remain unquantified.

downstream_consumers: composite result updater that updates the base and explicitly invalidates the old composite

results.summary: Python compileall completed without syntax or import compilation errors.
Stage 6.5 hostile repair suite passed 6/6 tests.
Full regression passed 138/138 tests, including all 118 pre-stage tests.

remaining_limitations: Existing dynamic-state v2 artifacts are base-relative and cannot be composed with a mechanism correction.
The joint covariance is block diagonal and omits base/correction posterior correlation.
Applying an active experiment updates the base and invalidates the composite; independent mechanism re-confirmation against that new base still requires newly collected evidence.
External trial completeness, real-person validity, and causal interpretation remain outside this artifact.
